title: Idle PC Game
author: Useful-Baseball-90
selftext: I've been using a program called Summer Engine to try and make an Idle/Clicker PC game. I've spent some time on it and I feel it's at a point where I need some people to test it to see how it plays. If anyone is interested I have an uploaded version on the Summer Games app, or I can do a google link drive. I know it still needs work and I am always down to hear some ideas on how to update the game. Currently I am making sure everything works and is correct and then I can start working on implementing proper PC part images. There's a lot of stuff behind era locks that you need to unlock. Everything in this game is coded, images, assets, is from Summer Engine.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Useful-Baseball-90 this post needs more detail on how you used AI in development. Saying you used AI isn't the same as explaining how. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process. We're trying to keep "check out my game" posts from taking over the sub. If you don't update, this may be removed.

replies.author: Useful-Baseball-90
replies.body: There really isnt much i can explain, the whole thing was made with an AI game engine. I updated the bottom text to reflect that but ultimately there isn't a whole lot I can say about the involvement.
